purpose: Binding A/B eval of the incumbent corpus's motion-and-transitions SKILL.md (Arm A) vs emil's AUDIT.md + STANDARDS.md (Arm B) — per design.md § Canon eval methodology (Req-1).

review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags the `ease-in` timing function on `.toast` as wrong-direction easing for an entrance
arm's review output flags `transform: scale(0)` as an invalid entrance value and cites a 0.9-0.97 (or equivalent non-zero) floor
arm's review output flags `transition: all` as animating unintended / non-GPU properties

review_fixtures.planted_defect: symmetric press/release timing on a deliberate action
review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags identical press/release duration as missing asymmetric (slow press / fast release, or vice versa per the arm's own rule) timing

review_fixtures.planted_defect: animation on a 100+/day keyboard-initiated action (command palette toggle)
review_fixtures.pass_condition: arm's review output flags the animation on the command-palette toggle as a frequency violation (recommends removal or a no-animation default)
arm's review output flags the absent reduced-motion guard as a required fix, not optional polish
arm's review output flags `transition: height` as a non-compositor property and recommends transform-based alternative (measured-height technique or max-height/scale substitute)

generation_fixtures.source: skills/motion-and-transitions/evals/evals.json (reused verbatim, per tasks.md 1.1 — no new prompts authored)
generation_fixtures.scoring_note: Judged blind to which curve family is used — score = compliance with shared feel rules only (reduced-motion guard present, duration under the arm's own UI ceiling, origin-awareness where applicable). Curve-token identity is scored separately under the easing_tokens dimension, not folded into generation-fixture pass/fail.

scoring_rule: Tie or <10% delta on a dimension: incumbent corpus incumbent stays canonical (design.md). A dimension win requires a real catch-rate or compliance delta, not a single-fixture edge case.
provenance: Upstream AUDIT.md/STANDARDS.md fetched verbatim from https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills (MIT) 2026-07-16 — eval fixtures only, never wired into any routing surface.
